content: scales 1.4.0 (CRAN, 2025-04-24): internal scaling infrastructure for ggplot2. Imports cli, farver, glue, labeling, lifecycle, R6, RColorBrewer, rlang, viridisLite. Already a transitive dependency of ggplot2. Provides label_percent(), label_dollar(), label_comma() for financial axes; scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::label_percent()), color palettes via viridisLite. No separate installation needed for most ggplot2 users.
